q: What areas does Bailey Electrical cover?
a: We're based in Cardiff and cover the city and roughly 20 miles around it, including Penarth, Barry, the Vale of Glamorgan, Cowbridge, Llantrisant, Pontypridd, Caerphilly and Newport. For larger projects such as rewires, extensions and renovations we're happy to travel further.

q: What kind of electrical work do you specialise in?
a: Full and partial rewires, consumer unit upgrades, electrics for extensions, kitchens, bathrooms and renovations, and indoor and outdoor lighting. We also carry out EICRs, landlord electrical certificates and fault finding.

q: Do you work with builders and other trades?
a: Yes. A lot of our work is alongside builders, kitchen and bathroom fitters and carpenters. We fit first and second fix around the build programme and handle the certification and Building Regulations sign-off.
Yes. Bailey Electrical carries full public liability insurance, and every installation is tested and certified on completion.
Yes. For most jobs we'll visit, agree a clear scope of work and give you a written quote before anything starts, so you know exactly what's included.

We concentrate on planned work rather than a 24/7 emergency service, which means we can give every job proper time and turn up when we say we will. If you have an electrical problem, call us and we'll help where we can.

q: How long does a house rewire take?
a: As a rough guide, a typical three-bedroom house takes around one to two weeks, depending on size, access and whether the house is empty. We'll give you a realistic timescale with your quote.

q: Do you work directly for homeowners?
a: Yes. You deal directly with the electrician doing the work, from the first visit to the final certificate. We also work as part of a builder's team on renovation projects.

q: Do you take on small jobs?
a: Our focus is planned work such as rewires, consumer units, renovations and lighting projects. We can often fit smaller jobs in when they're in Cardiff or alongside other work, so it's always worth asking.

q: How can I get an idea of what my rewire involves before you visit?
a: Use our free rewire quote builder at bailey-electrical.co.uk/rewire-quote-builder to choose sockets, lighting and extras room by room, then send it to us for a written quote. Not sure if you need a rewire? Try the 1-minute 'Do I need a rewire?' check.

q: Do you do landlord electrical certificates in Wales?
a: Yes. We carry out Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICRs) for landlords and letting agents across Cardiff, which landlords in Wales need at least every five years under the Renting Homes (Wales) rules, and we can carry out any remedial work needed.
